target.description: The SFTP server where the S3 gateway (`sftp-gateway`) stores the encrypted backups of Longhorn and the secrets of the apps.

url.description: `sftp://<user>@<host>[:<port>]/<path>`, or `sftp+tls://<user>@<host>[:<port>]/<path>` for a server behind a TLS SSH gateway (SSH inside TLS, SNI `<host>`, the certificate is not checked: the SSH host key is the authentication). The host is a DNS name (the network policy of the gateway allows it with `toFQDNs`), the port is 22 for `sftp` and 422 (the TLS SSH gateway) for `sftp+tls`, the path is the writable directory of the user, in its chroot. The user is the one of `bcl.role.backup.sftpUsers` of the NixOS config, its private key is the key `id_ed25519` of the secret `sftp-gateway`.

hostKeys.description: The host keys of the server, one line of `known_hosts` each, all the types of the server (only the type and the key are used).
